thesis_title: ULTRA Roman Urdu Extension & Dynamic Threshold
author: Hashim Shazad

research_question_1.question: Can Roman Urdu queries be handled effectively?
research_question_1.conclusion: Roman Urdu layer enables completely new capability

research_question_2.question: Can dynamic classifier beat static threshold?
research_question_2.conclusion: SVM classifier dramatically outperforms static θ=150

research_question_3.question: Which transformer model performs best?
research_question_3.conclusion: Multilingual model handles both Urdu and Roman Urdu
